name: Konbanmassuru!

boost.name: Muscle Greeting
effect: NOW: Draw 1.
+1 Speed if you initiated this Strike.
HIT: Draw 1. Gain Advantage.
description: 以Noel的招牌招呼語『こんばんマッスル！』為核心概念。高速輕擊配合抽牌搶回先手權，表現她活力十足的登場總能帶動氣氛。Boost進一步強化先手速度，體現她隨時充滿肌肉幹勁的招牌形象。

name: Massuru Metronome

boost.name: Rapid Vibrations
effect: +2 Speed for this Strike only.
HIT: Deal damage again at -1 Power (second hit).
description: 取自Noel的經典音效梗『マッスルメトロノーム』——高速肌肉震動的擬音。設計為二段攻擊，命中後追加第二次傷害，象徵她那不停歇的肌肉抖動，每一次震動都疊加傷害，愈抖愈強。

name: Iron Stomach

boost.name: Gyudon Time
effect: NOW: Gain 2 life.
AFTER: If this card was not used in a Strike, gain 2 life.
BEFORE: Gain 3 life.
HIT: You may discard any number of cards. Gain 1 life per card discarded.
description: 以Noel著名的『鉄の胃袋』（鐵胃）以及她對牛丼（Gyudon）的狂熱熱愛為設計。非攻擊性的回復支援卡，擁有高防禦與多段生命回復效果，表現她無論吃多少都能吸收的驚人消化力與大胃王體質。

name: Knight's Oath

boost.name: Shield Wall
effect: +2 Armor and +2 Guard this Strike.
Stun Immunity.
Ignore Armor.
HIT: Push 1. Gain Advantage.
description: 以Noel的騎士身份與粉絲群『白銀聖騎士團』為概念。高護甲的騎士踢擊，無視對手護甲並將其推開後搶回先手，表現她作為騎士團長兼具堅不可摧的防禦力與威嚴的推進氣勢。

name: Getting Over It

boost.name: Never Give Up
effect: X is also +1 for each card in your discard pile.
AFTER: Return this to your hand instead of your discard if it missed.
X equals the number of cards in your discard pile (max 6).
HIT: Gain Advantage and draw 1 card.
description: 致敬Noel的經典耐久直播《Getting Over It》——她花了數小時不斷失敗卻永不放棄。X值基於墓地牌數，越到後期越強，象徵她越挫越勇的耐久精神力。Boost讓此卡未命中時回收，體現她總會重新站起來繼續挑戰。

name: ASMR Sweet Dreams

boost.name: Whisper Lullaby
effect: BEFORE: Opponent discards 1 random card.
AFTER: If this Strike hit, the opponent draws 1 less card next turn.
HIT: Opponent skips their next Draw Phase (draw 0 cards next turn). Gain Advantage.
description: 以Noel曾是Hololive主要ASMR直播主的身份為靈感。輕柔的高速攻擊，命中後讓對手陷入『安眠』狀態（跳過抽牌階段），表現她那令人放鬆的ASMR嗓音能讓觀眾（對手）失去作戰意識，沉浸在溫柔之中。

name: Muscle Brain Charge

boost.name: Full Power Assault
effect: +2 Power.
HIT: You may take 1 damage to draw 2 cards.
Ignore Guard.
HIT: Push 2. Opponent discards 1 card.
description: 呼應Noel官方認證的『蓬鬆筋肉脳』設定——她總是憑直覺用蠻力解決問題。近距離全力衝撞，無視防禦、高傷害，配合推開與削手效果，表現她不假思索、用肌肉硬幹一切的直球風格。

name: Platinum Ring

boost.name: Eternal Promise
effect: +3 Power and Stun Immunity.
If you have 'Noefure Eternity' in your discard, +2 Speed.
Cannot be guarded.
HIT: Return up to 2 cards from your discard to your hand.
AFTER: Gain 2 life.
description: 與Flare對戒的對應卡，從Noel視角出發的羈絆奧義。致敬2021年兩人訂製白金對戒的經典事件——作為騎士團長守護最重要之人的決心。不可防禦的攻擊，命中後回收資源並回復生命，表現戒指帶給她的溫暖與力量。

name: Danchou's Final Stand

boost.name: Knight Order Charge
effect: NOW: Draw a card for each 'special' card in your discard (max 3).
+1 Power for each card drawn this way.
Stun Immunity.
HIT: Opponent discards their hand and draws 3 cards.
AFTER: You may advance up to 2 spaces.
description: 以Noel的騎士團長身份與粉絲群『白銀聖騎士團』為概念的最終決戰技。率領騎士團發動總攻擊，無視暈眩、強制對手重置手牌。Boost根據墓地特殊卡數量強化，表現團長集結全團之力、越戰越強的領袖氣質。

name: Noefure Eternity

boost.name: Bond of Platinum
effect: If you have a 'Platinum Ring' card in your discard, you may play it without paying its Force cost.
AFTER: If this Strike hit, add this card to your hand instead of your discard.
Cannot be guarded.
Cannot be dodged by effects.
HIT: Opponent discards their hand and takes 3 additional damage.
description: ノエフレ的最終奧義——Noel與Flare羈絆的全力釋放。極慢但毀滅性的最強攻擊，無法被防禦或閃避。若墓地有『Platinum Ring』則可免費施放Boost，且命中後此卡回手形成無限循環，象徵兩人的羈絆永無終點。
